allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Faze Three Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Nomination and Remuneration Committee Meeting held on August 11, 2026 for the purpose of (1). Allotment of 2,78,840 Equity shares of the Company to Faze Three Employee Trust under the Faze Three Employee Stock Option Scheme 2024 and (2). Change in Trustees of the said Trust.

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Faze Three Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the grant of options to purchase securities pursuant to the 'Faze Three Employee Stock Option Scheme 2024'.
